meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: Claude 会用 shadcn CLI 帮你添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI 组件（含聊天界面），并自动执行项目的编码规范，如优先用已有组件、用语义化颜色、布局用 gap 等。
howto.when: 项目里有 components.json 时，或你提到 shadcn/ui、组件注册表、preset 等关键词，或要求初始化或切换 preset 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 shadcn 添加一个 Dialog 组件。
say.note: 会先检查是否已安装，再通过 CLI 添加。

say.text: 搜索一下有没有现成的登录区块，别自己写。
say.note: 会运行 search 在注册表里找，而不是凭空造。

say.text: 修复这个表单的校验样式，改用 FieldGroup 规范。

howto.what_en: Claude manages shadcn projects via the CLI: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling and composing UI (including chat), while following the project's coding rules such as reusing existing components, semantic colors and gap-based layouts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the project has a components.json, when you mention keywords like shadcn/ui, component registries, or preset, or when you ask to initialize or switch presets.

say_en.text: Add a Dialog component with shadcn.
say_en.note: Checks installed list, then adds via CLI.

say_en.text: Search for an existing login block instead of writing one.
Fix this form's validation styling using FieldGroup.
say_en.note: Rewrites it to FieldGroup with data-invalid.
